BREAKING: $TGT 8-K filed Nov 12 — a CEO change: “Target Appoints Sally Grimes to Board of Directors • Grimes is former CEO of Diageo North America, Clif Bar & Company, and Group President at Tyson Foods, bringing …” How do you read it? #8K #leadership

“Target Appoints Sally Grimes to Board of Directors • Grimes is former CEO of Diageo North America, Clif Bar & Company, and Group President at Tyson Foods, bringing extensive experience across consumer brands, innovation, brand building and …
